extra.message: Four fixed plaintext account passwords, including an administrator password, are committed in source and inserted into the runtime user database.
The /api/search endpoint serializes the raw SQLite error object into the HTTP response. An attacker can submit malformed search input to obtain internal database error details.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: Attacker-controlled searchText from both search routes is concatenated directly into a SQLite query passed to db.all(). UNION-based input can alter the query and disclose records from the user table.

The error template returns error.stack to clients in development mode. Because the supplied runtime configuration does not set NODE_ENV to production, remotely triggered errors disclose stack traces and internal filesystem paths by default.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: The POST /search value searchText is rendered using Pug's unescaped != operator. An attacker can submit HTML or script markup that executes in the resulting page.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation
